reviews.title: Best economy upgrade made.
reviews.comment: So, I was going to build a new rig. AM 5 motherboards are still reasonably priced as are processors. Memory and storage prices are insane. So, I decided to upgrade my AM 4 board. For $219. oo this really made sense. I run 32 GB of DDR4 and a RTX360 TI GPU. Added a 360mm radiator and fans. Jumped up my power supply to 850W gold. For less than $500 I've got a lean mean gaming machine. Running Cyberpunk 2077 average of 35 fps higher then my ryzen 5 5500 did. Silent Hill 2 saw a 30 fps jump. It seems to run cooler than the old processor even with the silent mode cooling fan engaged
